name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-AMR
notes: Real, dependency-free coordination boundary for AGV/AMR fleets: a real, hand-checkable 2D rigid-body transform (FrameTransform) from the factory's shared coordinate frame into a specific AMR's local frame, a minimal VDA-5050-inspired order-action vocabulary (MOVE_TO_*/PICK_LOAD/DROP_LOAD/CANCEL_ORDER) gated through HYDRA-UMC-SDK's shared safety contract, and a real VDA 5050 MQTT publisher (Vda5050Publisher) that only ever publishes an already-gated dispatch to the correct real order/instantActions topic. Never plans a path or avoids an obstacle itself - that authority stays with the AMR's own onboard navigation or its fleet manager. Not yet exercised against a real fleet manager or physical AMR.
